items.title: Pay income tax back-payment for 2025
items.computation: The letter states an explicit due date of 30.04.2026 for the Nachzahlung. 30.04.2026 is a Thursday, not a weekend day or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Frist: ein Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter itself states the Bescheid was 'am 30.03.2026 zur Post gegeben' (Monday). Per § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by post is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after posting: 30.03. + 3 days = 02.04.2026 (Thursday). That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 02.04.2026. Per § 355 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruchsfrist runs from Bekanntgabe. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted, so the period starts 03.04.2026; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day (02.04.), i.e. 02.05.2026 (Saturday). Since 02.05.2026 is a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day under § 108 Abs. 3 AO / § 193 BGB: 03.05. (Sunday) is also non-working, so the deadline moves to Monday, 04.05.2026 (no NRW holiday intervenes).
